name: us-startup-1
description: Single-sided, icon-led minimalist San Francisco startup card. Lowercase geometric wordmark 'loomtree' sits top-left in the largest type (no legal suffix, not caps, no dictionary company word); name in heavy weight, then 'Product Designer'; contact block uses icons instead of labels, so Tesseract emits junk glyphs: envelope icon read as a stray 'M' before the email (plus an OCR space after '@'), map-pin icon read as '9' before the street number; unlabeled US phone '(415) 555-0123'; two-line 'City, ST ZIP' address; bottom row is the bare domain and a Twitter/X handle on one line ('loomtree.co  @mayamakes').
